subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Should OpenClaw require a terminal Responses event for every `openai-responses` compatible provider and, if so, which of the two open PRs should become the single canonical transport-boundary implementation?
rationale: Both branches prevent the reported false-success persistence, but they place the failure boundary differently and a strict EOF rule can affect non-OpenAI compatible providers that are currently tolerated.

options.title: Choose one canonical strict transport contract
options.body: Confirm that terminal-less Responses streams are provider failures, select one implementation, and consolidate the other PR’s useful tests or evidence before landing.

options.title: Preserve compatibility for selected endpoints
options.body: Keep existing EOF tolerance for explicitly supported nonconforming compatible providers and add an owner-defined capability or provider boundary rather than failing every terminal-less stream.

options.title: Pause both PRs pending contract evidence
options.body: Defer the change until maintainers define the supported Responses-provider terminal-event contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Choose one canonical strict transport contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that terminal-less Responses streams are provider failures, select one implementation, and consolidate the other PR’s useful tests or evidence before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: A current-main agents-runtime owner should make the provider-compatibility decision; the available evidence is insufficient to identify that person reliably.
